lead.headline: ThePeopleBeaters started the Raiders D in Foxborough
lead.dek: They cut the Patriots defense for the Raiders the day before the Raiders visited Gillette, got 0.00 from it, and lost to Drake Maye and UC by 17.42.

body: Dumbest move of the year. ThePeopleBeaters had the Patriots defense. On Saturday, the day before New England hosted Las Vegas, they cut it. For the RAIDERS defense. They took the team walking into Foxborough over the team that lives there. Explain that to me.

Here’s how it went. Drake Maye completed 26 of 34 passes for 374 yards and four touchdowns. He ran one in from 3 yards out too. New England won 45-17 and piled up 536 yards, a season high per ESPN. The Raiders defense got one sack and scored 0.00 for ThePeopleBeaters. Maye scored 39.46 for Unsportsmanlike Conduct, most of anyone in this league. UC won by 17.42.

It gets worse. ThePeopleBeaters also started Hunter Henry, who caught Maye’s 11-yard touchdown 24 seconds before halftime. So they started the touchdown and the defense that allowed it. Then on Wednesday they picked the Patriots defense back up as a free agent. Like nothing happened. Sorry, pal. You don’t get to come home after that.
Benedict Arnold would’ve kept the Patriots defense. Pathetic.

rankings.take: First place, and Tanner McKee is the newest quarterback on the roster. Burrow, St. Brown and LaPorta all have byes this week. Enjoy the view while it lasts.
Bucky Irving ran for a career-high 165 yards and hammball moved up to second. Sam Darnold threw two picks for them (8.30). Second place with that quarterback? Whatever.
Won by 46.32 while their namesake threw two interceptions and went negative. Third in Elo. The worst player on the roster is the one in the team name, and it’s working.
Hung 226.24, most of the week, and only got to fourth. Elo doesn’t care how loud you win. Neither do I.
Josh Allen ran for 121 yards in an overtime win, and now J’Allen is fifth. A Bills quarterback carrying a team in my power rankings. Disgusting.
Dropped from first to sixth, then cut both quarterbacks who started for them Sunday. Lamar Jackson and Baker Mayfield are out, per Sleeper. Bold. Stupid, but bold.
Seventh, behind a team that just cut its quarterbacks. Maye scored 39.46 and the sponsor still can’t crack the top five. RIGGED.
Most points in the league at 836.88, and eighth. They started DJ Moore, who never played, and lost by 1.94. Elo got this one right.
Puka Nacua caught 17 balls and they lost by 74.92. They started Romeo Doubs this time and he caught one. Ninth feels generous.
Cut the Patriots defense for the Raiders the day before the Raiders played in Foxborough. Tenth is a gift. In a 12-team league I’d rank them 13th.
Scored 69.56, lowest of the week, with two zeros in the lineup. One was Kyle Monangai, who Sleeper lists as out. Read the injury report.
Last again. Their kicker scored negative two, and they paid $3 for a new one. Best money they’ve spent all year.

recaps.headline: Split starts a receiver who sat out, loses by 1.94
recaps.body: Unforgivable. Split Safety Syndicate started DJ Moore at flex. Moore sat out Buffalo’s overtime win in Los Angeles with a shoulder injury, per ESPN. ZERO. Treylon Burks had 4.60 on the bench, and the final margin was 1.94. Jahmyr Gibbs ran 25 times for 151 yards and two scores in Arizona (37.70). Wasted. J’Allen Waffle Stompers rode Josh Allen, who ran 10 times for 121 yards and a touchdown (30.50). J’Allen also benched 76.14 and won anyway. Think about that. One team left a whole lineup on the bench. The other started a ghost. The ghost lost. Check who’s playing. It takes ten seconds.

recaps.headline: Micah’s defense picks off Micah’s quarterback twice
recaps.body: Pick a side. Micah parsons fan club started Tyson Bagent at Superflex and the Green Bay defense in the same game. The Packers won 31-7. Xavier McKinney intercepted Bagent twice, per ESPN, and Bagent went 12 of 21 for 87 yards (1.18). Micah’s defense scored 20.00, partly off Micah’s own quarterback. Christian Watson caught touchdowns of 42 and 53 yards (32.30). Dak Side of the Sun didn’t hedge. Malik Nabers caught 11 of 20 targets for 121 yards and the tying score at Washington (29.10). Jason Myers hit all five field goals in Seattle (23.00). Root for both teams in a rivalry game and they throw you out of Fenway. Micah lost by 11.22. Justice.

recaps.headline: Three Texans and Drake Maye carry the sponsor
recaps.body: I hate how this happened. Unsportsmanlike Conduct beat ThePeopleBeaters by 17.42, and the backbone was Houston. C.J. Stroud threw for 261 yards and ran in a 2-yard keeper at Tennessee (20.94). Ka’imi Fairbairn made four field goals (17.00). The Texans defense held the Titans to 3 points and 187 yards (16.00). That’s 53.94 from one game in Nashville. Parker Washington caught touchdowns of 51 and 27 yards in London (30.40). Jameis Winston threw for 326 yards and three scores for ThePeopleBeaters (25.74). Pat Freiermuth caught two more (21.50). Not enough. A Boston team leaning on Texans is like the Bruins borrowing a goalie from Montreal. It works. It still feels wrong. Take the win and go shower.

l_keys.line: 8 rec on 10 targets, 110 yds, 1 TD; 1 fumble lost

recaps.headline: Mendoza hangs 226.24 and leaves 84.16 sitting
recaps.body: Not even close. Mendozareamazingpicks scored 226.24 and beat Kingslayers by 74.92, the biggest margin of the week. Jaylen Warren took a catch 80 yards and a run 50 yards to the end zone at Pittsburgh (36.80). Per ESPN, nobody had done both in one game since Herschel Walker in 1986. Jacoby Brissett threw three touchdowns in a blowout loss at home (25.28). Jayden Daniels ran for 103 yards and two scores. From the bench (32.26). Kingslayers got 17 catches from Puka Nacua (37.70) and 383 passing yards from Matthew Stafford (27.32). They also started Romeo Doubs at Superflex. Doubs caught 1 ball for 16 yards on a day the Patriots scored 45 (2.60). Unbelievable. That’s on Kingslayers, not Doubs. Start him again next week or I riot.

w_keys.line: 15 car, 101 yds, 1 TD; 6 rec, 87 yds, 1 TD

recaps.headline: Rams of Steel’s kicker misses twice and goes negative
recaps.body: This team is cursed. Rams of Steel started David Montgomery, who ran 5 times for 11 yards before hurting his groin, per ESPN (1.10). Omarion Hampton ran 14 times for 33 yards (4.90). Harrison Mevis missed both his field goals Monday night (-2.00). Negative points. From a kicker. hammball didn’t need the help. Bucky Irving ran for a career-high 165 yards, per ESPN, and scored twice in Dallas (31.50). Jordan Love threw for 367 in a 31-7 rout of Chicago (25.28). Mike Evans (26.30) and Davante Adams (22.10) did their jobs. Nobody else showed up. A kicker who scores negative isn’t unlucky. He’s a double agent. Dead last in Elo, and earned.

w_keys.line: 21 car, 165 yds, 1 TD; 2 rec, 10 yds, 1 TD

recaps.headline: Shough wins by 46.32 with Tyler Shough below zero
recaps.body: The team is named after him, and he scored negative. WELL! It's The Big Shough started Tyler Shough at Superflex. He threw for 96 yards and two interceptions in a home loss to Minnesota (-0.16). Byron Murphy Jr. picked him off both times, per ESPN. Shough won by 46.32 anyway. Jared Goff threw three touchdowns and ran in another at Arizona (28.94). Garrett Wilson scored from 32 yards out on the Jets’ first drive (23.40). Skat’s BruteForce Theorem scored 69.56, lowest of the week. Skat started Kyle Monangai, who didn’t play for Chicago (0.00). Gunnar Helm caught nothing on one target (0.00). Losing to a team whose namesake went negative? I’ve seen the Jets play. This is worse. Somebody unplug this team.

awards.name: Manager of the Week
awards.body: Best score of the week by 41.90. Jaylen Warren piled up 188 total yards, per ESPN (36.80). Spencer Shrader went 5 for 5 on field goals (21.00). James Cook ran for 111 yards and two scores (22.80). Good week. One Patriot in the lineup, so A-minus.

awards.name: Lineup Crime
awards.body: DJ Moore never got on the field for Buffalo, and Split started him at flex anyway (0.00). Burks scored 4.60 sitting next to him. That swap wins the game by 2.66. They also put Michael Mayer, a tight end, in the Superflex spot: 1 catch, 2 yards (1.20). A tight end where the quarterback goes. Revoke his lineup privileges.

awards.name: Floor of the Week
awards.body: Went 0 for 2 on field goals Monday night. Greg Rousseau blocked the second one in overtime, per ESPN, and Buffalo kicked the winner after that. Sean McVay said the kicking game was not even close to good enough. Rams of Steel cut him two days later for Nick Folk. Took them long enough.

awards.name: Best Performance in a Loss
awards.body: A career-high 17 catches on 24 targets, per ESPN, for 138 yards and a touchdown. The Rams lost 37-34 in overtime, and Kingslayers lost by 74.92. Jahmyr Gibbs matched his 37.70 in Split’s loss. Same number, same result. Seventeen catches and you still lose to Buffalo. Figures.

awards.name: Patriot of the Week
awards.body: Ran 13 times for 64 yards and caught 3 for 21. His 5-yard touchdown put New England back ahead right after the Raiders tied it, per ESPN. Without him, maybe the Raiders win and ThePeopleBeaters look smart. Nobody wants to live in that world.
